feedback_correction.reason: Source identity audit: remove the unverified paper label A from archive specimen 0r2v3/CD45/C1. Exact numeric points, original source bytes and the separately unlinked Table2 outcome are unchanged. This is a metadata correction, not another specimen or another measurement.

new_sources.limitation: Author-curated same reference-film trace; logical source-series identity, not proof of an uninterrupted instrument acquisition. Unknown P/B retained null.

Table2 A is not explicitly mapped to this physical archive piece. Raw transition traces do not uniquely establish the authors onset-referenced midpoint without an extra branch/onset rule. P/B unreported.
Broad and low-T measurements lack an explicit common specimen identifier. Equal geometry in author notebooks is circumstantial, not a verified physical-specimen link.

conclusions: Five singleton independent groups leave four training specimens per held-out group; the unchanged gate requires five.
No baseline/augmented fit, effect size, uncertainty interval or mechanism claim was generated.
At least one further eligible independent singleton is needed just to run this small exploratory comparison; six would not establish a reliable benefit.
This is a separate measured-Tc pilot, not validation of or a replacement for Storm DFT Tc. Hurricane normal-state fitting has not started.
Magnetic and calorimetric observations remain archived but are not primary inputs; no additional eligible paired modality or pressure/doping series was established.
